**

il Gatto in Tirol

** **

Discover the charm of Tirol with il Gatto – where tradition meets modern Italian flair.

** **

Innsbruck: A Culinary Journey

** **

In the heart of Tirol, Innsbruck invites you to indulge in authentic Italian flavors at il Gatto. Our restaurant blends Alpine elegance with Mediterranean warmth, offering a unique dining experience in the very center of the city.

** **

Our Signature Dishes

** **
  • Kaiserschmarrn – Fluffy, caramelized, and served with fresh fruit or apple compote.
  • Tiroler Gröstl – A hearty mix of potatoes, onions, and crispy bacon, topped with a fried egg.
  • Risotto alla Milanese – Creamy saffron risotto, rich and aromatic.
  • Tiramisu – The classic Italian dessert, layered with coffee and mascarpone.
** **

Wine & Atmosphere

** **

Pair your meal with our carefully selected Italian wines or enjoy a glass of local Tiroler beer. The cozy, rustic-chic interior creates the perfect setting for a memorable evening.

** **

Why Visit il Gatto?

** **
  • Authentic Italian cuisine with a Tirol twist.
  • Fresh, seasonal ingredients sourced locally.
  • A warm, inviting atmosphere in the heart of Innsbruck.
  • Perfect for romantic dinners, business lunches, or family gatherings.
** **

Location & Contact

** **

Find us in the historic center of Innsbruck, just a short walk from the Goldenes Dachl and Hofburg. Open daily for lunch and dinner.
